title: Ma awarded AFP Foundation for Philanthropy grant to study generative AI and strategic giving
summary_en: O’Neill professor Ji Ma receives a national grant to study how AI-generated fundraising appeals affect donor behavior, trust, and charitable giving.
title_cn: Ma awarded AFP Foundation for Philanthropy grant to study generative AI and strategic giving

title: Simon part of NASEM report urging overhaul of U.S. care economy data infrastructure
summary_en: A National Academies report led by O’Neill professor Kosali Simon recommends stronger data systems to better measure the economic value of paid and unpaid care.
title_cn: Simon part of NASEM report urging overhaul of U.S. care economy data infrastructure
